identity.name: Rime Thimble
identity.summary: A pale steel thimble crowned with a small ice ridge.
identity.description: Costs 1 mana per activation. Deals 3 magical damage per affordable activation. Reduces each enemy strike this round by 1.
identity.lore: An old seamstress stitched winter into the hem of a coat.

effects.description: Costs 1 mana per activation. Deals 3 magical damage per affordable activation. Reduces each enemy strike this round by 1.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its frost trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

visual.brief: A pale steel thimble crowned with a small ice ridge.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: A pale steel thimble crowned with a small ice ridge.
